actor.description: The actor whose attestation key is being revoked. Must agree with the envelope subject. Cross-actor attestation revocation is invalid.

subject.description: Internal reference of the same actor: 'actor:<self-actor-id>'.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Emergency events signed by revoked_key with created_at strictly after this time are rejected; events signed before remain valid (no retroactive mode).

revoked_key.description: KeyId of the attestation key being revoked. Must be in the actor's attestation set at created_at (genesis-declared or appended via ActorAttestationKeyAdd). The resulting attestation set size must be >= the resulting attestation threshold.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason. Included in canonical bytes.

signatures.description: Each signature must be produced by a distinct key in the actor's attestation set at created_at. The verifier requires >= attestation_threshold_at(actor, created_at) entries with distinct key_id values. revoked_key MAY be among the signing keys (self-revocation contributes one signature toward threshold). Operational signing keys cannot revoke attestation keys. See ACTORS.md §5.5.2 / §5.5.3.
